note: Santillan 2015. Filing status: claimed single; legally married all year under California law, no decree of divorce or separate maintenance, separated during 2015 (moved to his mother's home; wife and children stayed in the family home); spouse filed her own return as HOH. Income: reported gross income 70,915 encoded as wages (travel reimbursements of 4,670 not in W-2 wages and not reported; NOD did not adjust them, so not added). Itemized deductions: respondent allowed 17,975 plus conceded real estate taxes 727 and points 1,802 = 20,504; petitioner conceded 8,888 mortgage interest/points. Unreimbursed employee expenses (26,969 claimed): findings show no substantiation for vehicle, travel, meals, business expenses, dues, phone; credible testimony on protective clothing/supplies (Home Depot 499 + other retailers 618 in 2015) but no showing that reimbursement was sought and denied under the employer's reimbursement policy, so no employee expense is included (any allowance would also face the 2% floor, ~1,418, above 1,117). Accuracy penalty conceded: not encoded. asFiled: single, wages 70,915, Schedule A total 55,947 (itemized).
inferred: reported gross income 70,915 treated entirely as wages
spouseAbsentLastSixMonths true (he moved out during 2015; exact month not stated) - moot as no child lived with him
employee business expenses allowed = 0 (reading of findings re reimbursement policy and substantiation)
unencodable: employee business expense allowance (§162/§274(d), reimbursement-policy rule, 2% floor) is not modelled: given only as the itemized total
travel reimbursements excluded from income (accountable plan question not modelled; not adjusted in NOD)
